title: Analysis-SpaceX ties Musk compensation to Mars colonization goal
title_zh: 分析-SpaceX将马斯克的薪酬与火星殖民目标联系起来
summary: By Ross Kerber April 28 (Reuters) - SpaceX's board has approved a compensation plan for founder Elon Musk with goals as futuristic and celestial as the company's ambitions: colonizing Mars and running
summary_zh: 罗斯·克伯 (Ross Kerber) 4 月 28 日（路透社）——SpaceX 董事会批准了创始人埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的一项薪酬计划，其目标与公司的雄心一样具有未来感和天象：殖民火星和运行

title: Google signs classified AI deal with Pentagon, The Information reports
title_zh: 据 The Information 报道，谷歌与五角大楼签署了机密人工智能协议
summary: STORY: Alphabet's Google has reportedly joined a list of tech firms to sign a deal with the U.S.
summary_zh: 故事：据报道，Alphabet 旗下的谷歌已加入与美国签署协议的科技公司名单。

title: OpenAI trial pitting Elon Musk against Sam Altman kicks off
title_zh: 埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 与萨姆·奥尔特曼 (Sam Altman) 的 OpenAI 试验开始
summary: A trial that could help shape the future of artificial intelligence begins on Tuesday, with billionaires Elon Musk and Sam Altman at odds over the evolution of ChatGPT maker OpenAI from a nonprofit to a ‌profit-seeking juggernaut worth hundreds of billions of dollars.
summary_zh: 一项可能有助于塑造人工智能未来的试验于周二开始，亿万富翁埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 和山姆·奥尔特曼 (Sam Altman) 对于 ChatGPT 制造商 OpenAI 从非营利组织演变为价值数千亿美元的逐利巨头的转变存在分歧。

title: Big Tech investors to gauge payoff as AI spending set to hit $600 billion
title_zh: 人工智能支出将达到 6000 亿美元，大型科技投资者将衡量回报
summary: Big Tech has spent hundreds of billions of dollars over three years to power the artificial intelligence boom.
summary_zh: 三年来，大型科技公司花费了数千亿美元来推动人工智能的繁荣。

title: The only number that matters for 'Magnificent 7' earnings this week: Morning Brief

summary: A deluge of Big Tech earnings this week will take center stage on Wednesday. One number will tell the story of the AI boom.
summary_zh: 本周大型科技公司的大量财报将在周三成为焦点。一个数字就能讲述人工智能热潮的故事。

title: Elon Musk vs. Sam Altman: What to know about the OpenAI case
